headline: Completed M52 by centralizing command-log temp and stderr state behind wrapper helpers.
current_focus: Current focus is keeping command-log shell regressions on wrapper-owned temp-path, stderr-log, core-path, and source-repo helpers while the next execution-state follow-up is selected.
milestone_target: M53: assess whether command-log python-command state still needs a wrapper-owned helper.
completed_work: Added self_host_command_log_tmp_root, self_host_command_log_tmp_path_for_relative_path, and self_host_command_log_stderr_log_path in scripts/self-host-command-log-test-lib.sh so command-log regressions can resolve wrapper-owned temp and stderr state without reaching into exported variables.

Updated scripts/test-self-host-artifact-command-log-first-command.sh, scripts/test-self-host-artifact-command-log-format.sh, scripts/test-self-host-artifact-command-log-path-helper.sh, and scripts/test-self-host-artifact-command-log-shared-fixtures.sh to consume the new wrapper helpers instead of reading SELF_HOST_COMMAND_LOG_TMP_REPO or SELF_HOST_COMMAND_LOG_STDERR_LOG directly.

Hardened scripts/test-self-host-artifact-command-log-wrapper-ownership.sh so command-log regressions now fail if they read wrapper-owned temp/stderr state variables directly and so the affected regressions must keep using the new wrapper helpers.

Marked M52 done in SELF_HOST_MILESTONES.json, added pending follow-up milestone M53, and refreshed SELF_HOST_COMMAND_LOG.json, SELF_HOST_PROOF.json, SELF_HOST_REPORT.json, and SELF_HOST_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.json for the focused verification suite.
next_steps: Use pending milestone M53 only if a future deterministic command-log regression needs wrapper-owned access to the python command state instead of SELF_HOST_COMMAND_LOG_PYTHON_CMD.
Extend the wrapper-ownership scan again if future command-log regressions add new wrapper-managed execution-state variables that should move behind helper functions.
note: Status is pass because verification succeeded, milestones_done increased from 51 to 52 versus the prior report, and M52 converted command-log temp/stderr state access into deterministic wrapper-owned helper coverage.
